Rashi on Gittin 63b:10:1.hebrew: משום חצרה הבאה לה לאחר מיכן - לאחר שנתן לה הבעל הגט בחצר של אחרים, קנאתו; דההוא לאו גיטא הוה, דבעינן "ונתן בידה" או בחצרה, דאיתרבאי מ"ידה", וזה בשעה שנתן, לא היה החצר שלה; וגזרינן שלא יקבל שליח האשה מיד שליח בעלה, משום דדמי להא — שקדם הבעל ומסרו ליד שליח, ואחר כך עשתה היא שליח לקבלו — ואתו נמי למימר: חצר הוי שליח הבעל, וכשקנאתו היא, נעשה החצר עצמו שלוחה:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:10:1.english: Due to her courtyard that comes to her afterward - [Where] after the husband gave her the get in someone else's courtyard, she acquired it; for that is not a [valid] get, since we require "and he shall place [it] in her hand" or in her courtyard, which is derived from "her hand," and this [courtyard], at the time he gave [it], was not hers; and we decree that the wife's agent may not receive [it] from the hand of her husband's agent, because it resembles this [case] — where the husband first handed it into the hand of an agent, and afterward she appointed an agent to receive it — and [people] would also come to say: the courtyard is the husband's agent, and when she acquires it, the courtyard itself becomes her agent:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:11:1.english: What is [the difference] between them - between these two versions:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:11:2.hebrew: דקדמה איהי ושויה שליח - דידה קודם שמסר הבעל ליד שלוחו, דהשתא לא דמי לחצר הבא לאחר מיכן:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:11:2.english: Where she first appointed an agent - hers, before the husband handed [the bill of divorce] into the hand of his agent, so that now it is not comparable to a courtyard that comes [into her possession] afterward:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:12:1.english: Let it be in your hand - and you shall be my agent for receipt:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:12:2.english: If it is so [according] to Rabbi Chanina - If I knew that the halakha is in accordance with him:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:12:3.hebrew: עבידנא - בהא מילתא עובדא כוותיה, ואמינא מגורשת, ולא חיישינן לחצרה הבאה לאחר מיכן:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:12:3.english: I would perform - an action in this matter in accordance with him [Rabbi Chanina], and I would say [that she is] divorced, and we are not concerned about her courtyard that comes afterward:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:13:1.hebrew: לא חזרה שליחות אצל הבעל - שליח שחזר ונעשה שליח למי שנשתלח לו, ניתק משליחות הראשון עד שלא היה לו שהות לחזור אצל שולחו ולומר "עשיתי שליחותך", ושליחות שאינה ראויה לחזור ולהגיד, אינה שליחות:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:13:1.english: The agency did not return to the husband - An agent who subsequently became an agent for the one to whom he was sent has been severed from the first agency before he had an opportunity to return to his sender and say, "I have performed your agency," and an agency that is not fit to return and report [its completion] is not a [valid] agency:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:14:1.english: We will consider the matter - We will examine it until our minds are settled [so as] to respond in accordance with the halakhah:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:15:1.hebrew: הדור שלחוה - לאחר ימים, לדעת מה נתיישב בדבר:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:15:1.english: They again sent it - After [some] days, to know what had been resolved regarding the matter:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:15:2.english: All these - All these times they repeatedly send [it]:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:16:1.english: It is a matter of forbidden relations - concerning which a doubt arose in the study hall:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:16:2.english: She performs ḥalitza and does not enter into levirate marriage - If [her husband] died [childless].

Rashi on Gittin 63b:17:1.english: There was an incident - like this [case]:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:17:2.hebrew: ואצרכה גט - אחר, משום דלא חזרה שליחות:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:17:2.english: And he required her [to receive] a bill of divorce - another [one], because the agency did not return [to the husband]:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:17:3.hebrew: תרתי - בתמיה: אם גט, למה חליצה משמת:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:17:3.english: Two?! - [This is asked] in astonishment: if [she receives] a bill of divorce, why [would she need] chalitzah once he dies?

Rashi on Gittin 63b:17:4.hebrew: גט מחיים - אם באת לינשא מחיים, צריכה גט שני:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:17:4.english: A bill of divorce while [he is] alive - If she comes to marry during [his] lifetime, she requires a second bill of divorce:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:17:5.english: And ḥalitza after death - If he died and did not give her a bill of divorce:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:18:2.hebrew: אזול סהדי - שאמר להם בעל: "כתבו גט ותנו לה":
Rashi on Gittin 63b:18:2.english: The witnesses went - [for] the husband had said to them: "Write a bill of divorce and give [it] to her":

Rashi on Gittin 63b:18:3.english: And they wrote Tefata - They erred in her name:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:18:4.hebrew: עשו עדים שליחותם - לגט אחד עשאם שלוחים ועדים, והרי כתבו גט אחד, ואינן שלוחים עוד לחזור ולכתוב גט כשר:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:18:4.english: The witnesses performed their agency - [The husband] appointed them [as] agents and witnesses for one bill of divorce, and behold, they have [already] written one bill of divorce, and they are no longer agents to go back and write a valid bill of divorce:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:19:1.english: And it was lost - before they gave it to her:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:19:2.hebrew: עשו עדים שליחותם - ואינן רשאין לכתוב גט שני וליתן לה, שהרי כבר כתבו גט כשר:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:19:2.english: The witnesses performed their agency - And they are not permitted to write a second bill of divorce and give [it] to her, since they already wrote a valid bill of divorce:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:1:1.hebrew: מאי לאו בהילך - קתני בה, ור' נתן היא, דפליג בהולך ומודה בהילך:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:1:1.english: What, is [it] not regarding "Here you are" - [that the Mishnah] teaches about it, and it is [in accordance with] Rabbi Natan, who disagrees regarding "Deliver" and agrees regarding "Here you are":

Rashi on Gittin 63b:21:1.hebrew: כתבו ותנו לשליח - לשליח שלי שמיניתי, וכן עשו ואבד בדרך; מי אמרינן עשו כל שליחותם ונסתלקו:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:21:1.english: Write and give to an agent - [Meaning,] to my agent whom I appointed, and they did so, and it was lost on the way; do we say [that] they have fulfilled their entire agency and have been dismissed [from it]?

Rashi on Gittin 63b:21:2.hebrew: או דלמא - האי נמי, עד שיבא גט לידה ותתגרש, עשאן שלוחין לכתוב, אלא לטירחא דידהו חש, שלא להטריחם בהולכה:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:21:2.english: Or perhaps - [In] this [case] too, until the get reaches her hand and she is divorced, he made them agents to write [it]; rather, he was concerned about their trouble, so as not to trouble them with delivering [it]:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:22:1.hebrew: א"ל רבינא לרב אשי ויוליך לה מהו - את"ל בהך דלא אמר אלא "כתבו ותנו לשליח", והם כתבו ונתנו לו ואבד, דעשו שליחותם — דהא כל מה שצום גמרו ועשו — הכא מאי? מי אמרינן: כיון דאמר "כתבו ותנו לשליח ויוליך לה", עשאן שלוחים לחזור ולכתוב עד שיגיע לידה — לכך פירש להם כל כך — או דלמא לא שנא:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:22:1.english: Ravina said to Rav Ashi: "And he will deliver [it] to her," what is [the law]? - If you conclude [to say] in that [previous case] — where he only said, "Write and give [it] to an agent," and they wrote [it] and gave [it] to him and it was lost — that they have fulfilled their agency, because everything that he commanded them they completed and did, here what [is the law]? Do we say: since he said, "Write and give [it] to an agent, and he will deliver [it] to her," he made them agents to write [it] again until it reaches her hand — for that reason he specified so much to them — or perhaps there is no difference:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:23:1.hebrew: ה"ג - טול לי, שא לי, יהא לי בידך כו':
Rashi on Gittin 63b:23:1.english: This is how we read [the text] - "Take for me," "Lift for me," "[Let it] be for me in your hand," etc.:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:24:1.english: A woman who said, "Receive my bill of divorce for me" - and he [the agent] came back and said, "I received [it]":

Rashi on Gittin 63b:24:2.hebrew: צריכה - להביא לפנינו ב' כיתי עדים:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:24:2.english: [She] requires - to bring before us two sets of witnesses:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:24:3.english: Two [witnesses] who say, "In our presence she said" - to him to receive it:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:24:4.hebrew: ושנים שיאמרו בפנינו קבל וקרע - ובגמרא פריך, למה לו למיקרעיה:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:24:4.english: And two who say: In our presence he received [it] and tore [it] - And in the Gemara it asks: Why must he tear it?

Rashi on Gittin 63b:24:5.hebrew: אפי' הן כו' - שהשנים שאמרה בפניהם, הן עצמן ראו כשקבלו:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:24:5.english: Even [if] they, etc. - [This means] that the two [witnesses] in whose presence she spoke are themselves the ones who saw when he received it:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:2:1.english: If the husband said to him, etc. - It is our Mishnah:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:3:1.english: What, [is it] not [a case of] “Here you are” - [that] we learned in the Mishnah:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:5:1.hebrew: נעשה שלוחו ושלוחה וחולצת - אם מת הבעל קודם שהגיע גט לידה, חולצת ולא מתייבמת:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:5:1.english: He becomes his agent and her agent, and she performs chalitzah - If the husband died [without children] before the get [bill of divorce] reached her hand, she performs chalitzah and does not enter into levirate marriage:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:6:1.hebrew: מספקא ליה אי הולך כזכי - ונתגרשה בקבלתו של זה, אי לאו כזכי:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:6:1.english: He was uncertain whether "deliver" is like "acquire" - and she is divorced through this [agent's] receipt [of the get], or [whether] it is not like "acquire":

Rashi on Gittin 63b:6:2.hebrew: חייב - המשלח באחריותו, שהרי לא צוהו המלוה לשולחו:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:6:2.english: He is liable - [meaning] the sender [is liable] for its responsibility, since the lender did not instruct him to send it:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:6:3.english: And if he seeks to retract, he cannot retract - Thus, [saying "deliver"] is like [saying] "acquire":

Rashi on Gittin 63b:7:1.hebrew: ספק ממונא לקולא - והמוציא מחבירו ידו על התחתונה, לפיכך אינו חוזר:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:7:1.english: An uncertainty [regarding] monetary [law is ruled] leniently - And [the rule is that] the one who seeks to exact [money] from his fellow has the lower hand; therefore, he cannot retract [it]:

Rashi on Gittin 63b:9:1.hebrew: משום בזיון דבעל - כסבור הבעל: "קלותי בעיניה, שאינה מקבלתו בעצמה"; דאילו כי עבדא שליח לקבל מיד הבעל, אין כאן חשש בזיון, דהא ידע ולא קפיד:
Rashi on Gittin 63b:9:1.english: Due to contempt for the husband - [The husband] thinks: "I am lightly esteemed in her eyes, [in] that she does not receive it herself [from my agent]." Whereas when she appoints [an agent] to receive [it] from the husband's hand, there is no concern of contempt here, for he knows [of it] and does not mind:

Tosafot on Gittin 63b:11:1.english: Where she first appointed an agent from the outset - [The Gemara] could have said that there is [a difference] between them where the husband does not object:

Tosafot on Gittin 63b:20:1.hebrew: כותבין ונותנין אפי' ק' פעמים - נראה לר"י, היכא דלא נאבד הגט, אלא שמסופקין בו אם נעשה כתיקון אם לאו, דאין לעשות אחר, שהרי עשו שליחותן אם הוא כשר; לפיכך טוב ללמד את הבעל שיצוה לעשות כמו שירצו עד שיצאו מן הספק:
Tosafot on Gittin 63b:20:1.english: They write and give [it] even one hundred times - It appears to Rabbi Yitzḥak [that] where the bill of divorce was not lost, rather they are in doubt regarding it whether it was made properly or not, one may not make another, for they have [already] fulfilled their agency if it is valid; therefore, it is good to instruct the husband to command [them] to make [as many] as they wish until they emerge from the doubt:

Tosafot on Gittin 63b:24:1.hebrew: אפי' הן הראשונים והן האחרונים - וא"ת: מאי "אפילו"? אדרבה, הכי עדיף טפי, דלא הוי חצי דבר! וי"ל: משום דבכת אחת דומה לשקר, דהיכי מתרמי שהיו בשעת אמירה ובשעת קבלה? וגבי גט הוה לן למיחש שמא שכרתם האשה, כדאשכחן בסוף פירקין באומר "אמרו", שמא תשכור עדים. והדר קאמר "או אחד מן הראשונים ואחד מן האחרונים ואחד מצטרף עמהם" — אפילו לאותו יחידי לא חיישינן שמא שכרתו. וא"ת: לר' עקיבא דאמר במרובה (ב"ק דף ע.) ובחזקת הבתים (ב"ב דף נו:) "דבר ולא חצי דבר", היכי מכשרינן הכא שתי כיתי עדים? וי"ל: דלמ"ד בגמרא "שליש נאמן", לא צריכי עדי אמירה לעדי קבלה, וכוליה דבר הוא; ואפילו למ"ד "בעל נאמן", ה"מ כששלשתן בעיר — בעל, שליש, ואשה — כמו שאפרש בגמ'; הלכך, כיון דאם אין שלשתן בעיר לא צריכי עדי אמירה לעדי קבלה, כוליה דבר הוא:
Tosafot on Gittin 63b:24:1.english: Even if the first [witnesses] and the latter [witnesses] are the same - And if you ask: What is [the meaning of] "even"? On the contrary, this [case] is even better, for it is not a "half-matter" [of testimony]! And one can answer: Because with one set [of witnesses], it looks like falsehood — for how did it happen by chance that they were [present both] at the time of [her] statement and at the time of [the agent's] receipt? And regarding a bill of divorce, we would have [reason] to suspect that perhaps the woman hired them, as we find at the end of our chapter regarding one who says, "Tell [so-and-so to write a bill of divorce]," [where we are concerned] lest she hire witnesses. And then [the Mishnah] says: "Or one from the first [set] and one from the latter [set], and one [other person] joins with them" — [meaning] even regarding that single [witness who was present at both events], we do not suspect that perhaps she hired him. And if you ask: According to Rabbi Akiva, who says in [the chapter entitled] Merubah (Bava Kamma 70a) and in [the chapter entitled] Chezkat HaBatim (Bava Batra 56b), "[A whole] matter, and not a half-matter," how do we validate two sets of witnesses here? And one can answer: According to the one who says in the Gemara [that] "the third party [i.e., the agent] is believed," the witnesses to the statement do not need the witnesses to the receipt, so it is a complete matter; and even according to the one who says [that] "the husband is believed," that applies only when all three of them are in the city — husband, third party, and wife — as I will explain in the Gemara; therefore, since if all three of them are not in the city the witnesses to the statement do not need the witnesses to the receipt, it is a complete matter:
